name: Pathfinder Kingmaker
format: Unity preferences in Windows Registry; exact binding value types/payload need inspection
limitations: A native keybinding file analogous to Wrath of the Righteous settings.json has not been established for Kingmaker.
A future deliverable should change only verified binding values and preserve value types, unrelated preferences and exact rollback. A whole-branch overwrite is not an acceptable shortcut.
A registry export may contain non-binding preferences; the bundle remains private.
